LanguageData.StrategicOutpost_ManageOutpost_Desc: Open the strategic outpost management interface to assign personnel, set production, and configure logistics.

LanguageData.StrategicOutpost_EmptyGuideText:
To found your first outpost: 1. Form a caravan at your colony with at least two capable colonists. 2. Move the caravan to an unoccupied world tile and halt it. 3. Select the caravan and click "Found Outpost" on the caravan gizmo bar.
Once founded, manage production, send resources, and recall staff via transport pods directly from this tab.
